identity.symptom: cancelled installer overwrites rolled back files

what: Cancelling relkit add can let an installer descendant overwrite restored project source and both lock formats.
expected: Cancellation settles the native child and both inherited output pipes before transaction rollback restores source and lock files.
observed: Cancellation completed early; a native installer descendant subsequently overwrote the restored source, bun.lock, and bun.lockb.
root_cause: packages/create-relkit/src/generator-process.ts nativeRun uses interruptible wrappers for native drain promises but the finalizer only joins the immediate child.
fixed_by: Acquire the native stdout/stderr Promises once and retain an allSettled barrier. Uninterruptible process release joins child exit and both physical drains before transaction rollback, preserving primary and cleanup error handling.

invariants: Cancellation settles the native child and both inherited output pipes before transaction rollback restores source and lock files.
Cancellation retains RELKIT_ADD_CANCELLED with exit 130; unrelated files, primary errors and cleanup evidence survive.

environment.revision: HEAD e081bde6054c8395209cdec145d8217c5d9c0dfd with uncommitted changes; baseline.json and after-baseline.json retain per-file SHA-256.
environment.target: Local macOS; Bun 1.3.10 and installed Effect 4.0.1; temporary loopback HTTP server and temporary project fixtures.
environment.monitoring: Existing operation observation and error/cleanup presentation exercised by native test harnesses. No external monitoring service was required or accessed.

reproduction: Write original value.ts, bun.lock, and bun.lockb in a temporary project.
Apply an installing update through the public facade and wait for the native installer descendant to request its release gate.
Abort; wait for immediate-child exit, then release the descendant to write all three files.
Await public cancellation and descendant exit; assert original bytes, cancellation code/exit status, and no temporary files.

limitations: The broad test:packages run is not claimed as passing: it encountered compiler timeouts and missing-module failures after root node_modules disappeared. The read-only repos/effect checkout lacks core Effect/Scope reference files; API behavior was verified against installed effect 4.0.1 source and native runtime tests.

notes: Both reported failures were reproduced and recorded before editing either application adapter.
Initial generator/package runs overlapped and hit time limits; generator acceptance and guardrail retries passed in isolation without deadline changes.
Source edits use existing adapters and resource scopes; no exports, dependency pins, commits, staging, pushes or protected documents were changed.
